name: @adsonbread/react
description: AdsOnBread SDK for browser extensions — vanilla JS and React ad slots.

scripts.check: node --check sdk.js && node --check test-sdk.js && node --check react.js && node --check viewability.js
scripts.example:vanilla: mkdir -p examples/vanilla-extension/vendor && cp sdk.js examples/vanilla-extension/vendor/adsonbread-sdk.js && cp test-sdk.js examples/vanilla-extension/vendor/adsonbread-test-sdk.js
